brief: Trial NCT03684694 (ADC Therapeutics). Why did it stop, and was the drug it tested (loncastuximab tesirine) ever approved by the FDA, and when?

findings.claim: Trial NCT03684694 was terminated due to an "Administrative decision", which is categorized as business/strategic.
Trial NCT03684694 started on December 1, 2018, and its primary completion and completion date was November 8, 2022, with an enrollment of 136 patients.
Results for trial NCT03684694 are posted on ClinicalTrials.gov (first posted on February 6, 2024), with a results_due_date of November 8, 2023, and was 90 days late.
Loncastuximab tesirine was approved by the FDA under BLA 761196 (brand name ZYNLONTA) on April 23, 2021.
findings.notes: Approved under active ingredient LONCASTUXIMAB TESIRINE-LPYL by sponsor ADC Therapeutics SA.

args.sql: SELECT t.nct_id, t.title, t.sponsor, t.phase, t.overall_status, t.why_stopped, d.why_stopped_category, t.start_date, t.primary_completion_date, t.completion_date, t.enrollment, d.results_posted, t.results_first_post_date, d.results_due_date, d.days_late, t.interventions, t.drug_names FROM trials t JOIN trial_derived d USING (nct_id) WHERE t.nct_id = 'NCT03684694'
